name: megascenes-business-card
description: Design a business card with your name, title and contact details as readable text, in the style you want.

interface.longDescription:
Give your name, job title, company and contact details, and describe the look: minimal, bold, elegant, playful. You get the front of the card with your details laid out as text on the design.

ChatGPT tells you what the design needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For freelancers, small businesses, events and new jobs.

Limitations: one side of the card per run, as an image; it is not a print file with bleed and crop marks. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design the front of a business card
Lay out your name and contact details as text
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a minimal business card for Anna Rossi, interior designer
Design an elegant black and gold business card for my bakery
Create a bold business card for a personal trainer

positive.prompt: Which models can design a business card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The business card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Design a minimal business card for Anna Rossi, interior designer, anna@example.com. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which model is best for small, legible text on a business card?
positive.expected_behavior: The models with their settings, to choose one for small text. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Design a minimal business card for Anna Rossi, interior designer, anna@example.com. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my business card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my business card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
